craft_notes: Sthāyin: acknowledgement of the bearer. Device: comma→dash both lines (bearing held throughout). Rejected: 'crown' for 'chaplet' — killed: chaplet humbler, fits offering-hands. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Hard highway of the quit, high chaplet of ken —
uttermost rim of hungerless, their bearer, Lord, is liege.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vairāgyasya gatiṃ gurvīṃ jñānasya paramāṃ śriyam naiḥspṛhyasya parāṃ koṭiṃ bibhratāṃ tvaṃ prabho prabhuḥ

reads_against.argmap: Weighty course of dispassion, supreme glory of knowledge, highest peak of desirelessness.; Of bearing these, you, O lord, are lord. → You bear dispassion, knowledge, desirelessness: you are lord.
c1_essence: Bearer of freedom's road, wisdom's crown, hunger's ridge: lord.
reads_against.l2: Freedom's hard road, wisdom's high crown, hunger's last ridge — their bearer, lord, is you.
